content: In the alternate seven-tiered hierarchy of his R. Madārij Afhām al-Afwāj, Ibn Turka is more explicit about the seventh level: it consists of the members of the House of the Prophet, those among the perfected saints of Islam who can riddle their cryptic utterances, and the sages of antiquity, who are disciples of the prophets of God.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Madārij Afhām al-Afwāj
